_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a king of bears who was of signal service to
 Rāma at the siege of Laṅkā. He was also noted for his medical skill.
 [This same Jāmbavat appears to have lived up to the time of Kṛṣṇa,
 or perhaps he was another being of that time; for there was a fight between
 Kṛṣṇa and Jāmbavat for the {%Syamantaka%} jewel which the latter
 had got from Prasena, brother of Satrājit. Kṛṣṇa vanquished Jāmbavat,
 who placed the jewel, along with his daughter Jāmbavatī, at his entire disposal.]
